name: MonarchBusinessHoursEditor
title: BusinessHoursEditor
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Column of sections: MonarchTextField, MonarchFormField with androidx.compose.material3.DatePickerDialog and DatePicker, MonarchTimezoneSelect, MonarchWeeklyHoursEditor, MonarchSelect, androidx.compose.material3.HorizontalDivider and MonarchCheckboxRow
summary: Edits a business-hours calendar: name, time zone, weekly hours, optional effective dates, holidays and special-hours dates, and whether it is the default.
whenToUse: For support, SLA or office-hours settings, where a calendar needs a zone, a weekly pattern and dates that replace it.
whenNotToUse: For a person's weekly availability alone use MonarchWeeklyHoursEditor; for people's time off use MonarchTimeOffPanel.
api: @Composable fun MonarchBusinessHoursEditor(value: MonarchBusinessHoursValue, onValueChange: (MonarchBusinessHoursValue) -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, showName: Boolean = true, showDefault: Boolean = false, showEffectiveDates: Boolean = false, allowSpecialHours: Boolean = true, requireName: Boolean = false, requireOpen: Boolean = false, showErrors: Boolean = false, pinnedTimeZones: List<String> = emptyList(), firstDayOfWeek: Int? = null, is24Hour: Boolean? = null, step: Int = 15, enabled: Boolean = true, readOnly: Boolean = false, addIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, removeIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, labels: MonarchBusinessHoursEditorLabels = MonarchBusinessHoursEditorLabels(), weeklyHoursLabels: MonarchWeeklyHoursEditorLabels = MonarchWeeklyHoursEditorLabels(), content: (@Composable ColumnScope.() -> Unit)? = null)

data class MonarchBusinessHoursValue(timeZone: String, hours: List<MonarchWeeklyHoursInterval> = emptyList(), exceptions: List<MonarchBusinessHoursException> = emptyList(), name: String = "", default: Boolean = false, effectiveFrom: Long? = null, effectiveTo: Long? = null) { fun validate(requireName: Boolean = false, requireOpen: Boolean = false): MonarchBusinessHoursErrors }
data class MonarchBusinessHoursException(date: Long?, name: String, intervals: List<MonarchBusinessHoursInterval> = emptyList())

options.name: value
options.description: The calendar: zone, weekly hours, exceptions, name, default flag and effective dates (UTC midnight epoch millis).

options.name: onValueChange
options.description: Called with the whole new value after every change; call value.validate() for the problems.

options.name: showEffectiveDates
options.description: Shows Effective from and Effective until, each with Clear.

options.name: allowSpecialHours
options.description: Lets an exception be open at other times, not only closed all day.

options.name: requireName
options.description: A name is required (the web's validation.requireName).

options.name: requireOpen
options.description: At least one open interval is required (the web's validation.requireOpen).

options.name: showErrors
options.description: Shows every error now; otherwise a field's error shows once it is changed.

options.name: pinnedTimeZones
options.description: Zones listed first in the time zone picker.

options.name: firstDayOfWeek
options.description: First weekday row (the web's weekStartsOn), Calendar.SUNDAY to Calendar.SATURDAY. null follows the locale, as the system calendar does; the web defaults to Monday.

options.name: is24Hour
options.description: 24-hour clock; null follows the device setting.

options.name: readOnly
options.description: Shows everything as text without controls.

options.name: addIcon / removeIcon
options.description: Icons of Add date and of the remove buttons; Monarch bundles none.

options.name: weeklyHoursLabels
options.description: Replacements for the strings of the weekly hours.

options.name: content
options.description: Extra content at the end, for example product-specific settings.

states.name: empty
states.description: No weekly hours and the note No holidays or exceptions.

states.name: closed date
states.description: A row with its date, its name and Closed all day.

states.name: special hours
states.description: Open at other times adds opening and closing menus, 10:00 to 16:00 to start.

states.name: errors
states.description: Missing name, no open interval, a row without a date or name, a date listed twice, special hours that close before they open, and an end date before the start date show in the danger color.

states.name: read-only
states.description: The name, dates, zone and hours are text; there are no add or remove buttons.

appearance: A form of sections on the screen's background: Monarch text fields, buttons and menus, a subheading for the holidays, help and notes in the muted text color, errors in the danger strong color and subtle dividers between rows. Light, dark and both high-contrast themes follow the theme roles.
platformNotes: The web lays the name and dates out in a grid and each exception as one row of inline controls; on a phone each exception is a stacked group (date button, name field, menu, times, remove), the phone's form layout. Dates are epoch milliseconds of UTC midnight from the Material 3 DatePickerDialog, not ISO strings; weekdays are ISO 1 to 7 as in MonarchWeeklyHoursEditor. The web reports errors with each change (onValueChange(value, errors)); here onValueChange takes the value and MonarchBusinessHoursValue.validate gives the errors, so the app calls it when saving. The web's isDefault is default, weekStartsOn is firstDayOfWeek, hourCycle is is24Hour and the validation object is requireName and requireOpen. After a row is removed the web moves focus to the next remove button; Android leaves focus to the system. The time zone picker is MonarchTimezoneSelect, which has no read-only mode, so read-only shows the zone id as text. iOS has no BusinessHoursEditor yet. The parity map lists time-off-panel as a dependency; the editor does not embed MonarchTimeOffPanel, because a calendar's holidays are dates of the calendar, not people's time off; its date dialog follows the same Material 3 pattern.
accessibility: Each date is a labelled field (Date 1, Effective from) whose button reads the chosen date or Choose a date and opens the Material 3 date dialog.
Each row's name, menu and times are labelled with the row's position (Name of date 1, Hours on date 1, Opening time of date 1).
The remove button is named by the date's name (Remove Christmas Day) or position, with a 48dp target.
Errors are text in the danger color, announced through a polite live region.
The holidays heading has heading semantics; Default is a checkbox row read as one control.
edgeCases: A new row has no date and no name; its errors wait until the row is changed or showErrors is set.
A saved time off the step grid stays selectable.
The editor is several screens tall and does not scroll: put it in a scrolling screen.
An exception may hold several intervals in the data; the editor edits the first and keeps the rest.
